name: DROP
intro: DROP 是报告集中常见的阅读理解 benchmark，强调在段落问答中进行离散推理与数值计算。
build_method: Wikipedia筛选, 对抗式众包, 多答案验证
build_method_en: Wikipedia curation, adversarial crowdsourcing, multi-answer validation
intro_en: DROP is a common reading-comprehension benchmark in the reports, emphasizing discrete reasoning and numerical computation over passages.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:1903.00161. DROP selects about 7,000 narrative or number-rich Wikipedia passages, especially NFL summaries, history, and passages with at least 20 numbers. AMT workers receive five random passages, write at least 12 QA pairs using five discrete-reasoning categories, and may submit only questions that a live BiDAF reader misses. Answers are passage/question spans, dates, or numbers with explicit units. The 96,567 questions are split by passage into 77,409/9,536/9,622. Dev/Test get at least two extra answers; 0.7% invalid items are removed. Evaluation uses normalized EM and numeracy-aware macro F1 with greedy multi-span alignment and a maximum over gold answers.
